sets.name: Verdite Armor
sets.desc: Heal 1 health per second when unhurt for 5 seconds.

sets.name: Azurite Armor
sets.desc: Jump again in mid-air, never take fall damage, hold sneak to glide.

sets.name: Cinderite Armor
sets.desc: Immune to fire, reflect melee hits and set attackers ablaze, and scorch everything that stands close.

sets.name: Tempest Armor
sets.desc: Two extra jumps, shock attackers, and lightning that picks off whoever stands near you.

sets.name: Sanguine Armor
sets.desc: Heal from the damage you deal, take less once you are hurt, and mend quickly when left alone.

sets.name: Chronal Armor
sets.desc: Abilities recharge faster, some hits are simply not there, and being struck slows everything near you.

sets.name: Voidwalker Armor
sets.desc: Three extra jumps, attacks that sometimes miss you entirely, and a cold that slows and wears down everything near you.

sets.name: Seraph Armor
sets.desc: You shed light that exposes and burns nearby enemies, hits land softer, and wounds close quickly when you are left alone.

sets.name: Apex Armor
sets.desc: Hits land a fifth softer, every ability recharges forty percent faster, and everything near you is worn down while you recover.

sets.name: Rimeguard Armor
sets.desc: You carry a cold that slows and wears down everything near you - and freezes some of it solid. Attackers are frozen where they stand, and wounds close quickly when you are left alone.

sets.name: Blightbound Armor
sets.desc: Everything near you rots, and every rotting thing feeds you. Hits land a quarter softer, and wounds close quickly when you are left alone.

sets.name: Starborn Armor
sets.desc: You fly. Six stars circle you and cut whatever they touch, and every ability recharges more than twice as fast.

sets.name: Eternal Armor
sets.desc: A killing blow is refused: you stand back up whole and everything near you stops. Everything near you is worn down while you recover, abilities recharge two and a half times as fast, and hits land a third softer.

mobs.name: Ember Imp
mobs.lore: A scrap of Ignarok's heat given a grudge and wings.

mobs.name: Storm Wisp
mobs.lore: A knot of weather that learned to aim.

mobs.name: Storm Pylon
mobs.lore: Anchors the Regent's shield. Break it.

mobs.name: Blood Bat
mobs.lore: Feeds on what its mother bleeds. Feeds her in return.

mobs.name: Thornback
mobs.lore: A boar that decided armour was a lifestyle. It charges anything that moves after dark.

mobs.name: Moss Wisp
mobs.lore: A scrap of lamplight that learned to spit.

mobs.name: Cave Stalker
mobs.lore: Hunts in the dark between the ore veins. It always jumps first.

mobs.name: Crystal Golem
mobs.lore: A geode that stood up. Do not hit it where it glitters.

mobs.name: Sky Wyvern
mobs.lore: Hunts by moonlight. The dragon's smaller, angrier cousin.

mobs.name: Cinder Hound
mobs.lore: Hunts in packs along the basalt shores. The fire is not decoration.

mobs.name: Magma Brute
mobs.lore: What a lava seam looks like when it gets tired of being a seam.

mobs.name: Ash Wraith
mobs.lore: What is left of a visitor who stayed too long. It still throws things.

mobs.name: Thunder Hawk
mobs.lore: Rides the front of every storm Voltaris has ever called.

mobs.name: Leech Thrall
mobs.lore: Hemorath's leftovers. They keep what they take.

mobs.name: Clockwork Sentinel
mobs.lore: Still counting. It has been counting for a very long time.

mobs.name: Hourglass Wraith
mobs.lore: A minute that wandered off from its hour.

mobs.name: Void Spawn
mobs.lore: What falls out when a rift opens. It is mostly teeth.

mobs.name: Null Anchor
mobs.lore: Pins the Devourer to the world. Break it and it falls.

mobs.name: Void Stalker
mobs.lore: Tall, patient, and always standing somewhere you have just looked away from.

mobs.name: Rift Weaver
mobs.lore: Sews doors into the air and then wonders who opens them.

mobs.name: Radiant Sentinel
mobs.lore: Built to guard a morning. Nobody told it the morning ended.

mobs.name: Prism Drone
mobs.lore: A lamp that learned geometry. Do not look straight at it.

mobs.name: Halo Blade
mobs.lore: A sword that stopped waiting for a hand.

mobs.name: Apex Pylon
mobs.lore: Holds the two halves of the Omnarch a little too close together.

mobs.name: Rime Wraith
mobs.lore: A winter that learned to hunt.

mobs.name: Rime Anchor
mobs.lore: Pins the winter to the world. Break it and the cold has nowhere to stand.

mobs.name: Glacial Brute
mobs.lore: A glacier that took one step and kept going.

mobs.name: Spore Pod
mobs.lore: Small, round, and absolutely certain it has a purpose.

mobs.name: Blight Heart
mobs.lore: It keeps the plague beating. Stop it and the plague has no rhythm.

mobs.name: Blight Crawler
mobs.lore: Eight legs would have been enough. Something added more.

mobs.name: Mycelid
mobs.lore: A mushroom that was told it could go anywhere.

mobs.name: Star Sprite
mobs.lore: A spark that got ideas about being a star.

mobs.name: Astral Node
mobs.lore: Holds the sky to its place. Drop it and the sky starts to fall.

mobs.name: Comet Hound
mobs.lore: It left a tail across half the sky and brought the other half with it.

mobs.name: Loom Spindle
mobs.lore: Holds the Final Thread taut. Cut it and the thread has to hold itself.
